explication: mpv-android is an Android video player built around libmpv. Users choose a local file, document, or URL from the main screen, then play it through the player screen; playback controls, subtitle and playlist dialogs, gestures, and background playback extend that experience. The graph also preserves documented decoding and rendering capabilities. Relationships among sampled app modules are supported by excerpts or the source index; several feature details are documented in the README rather than verified in sampled implementation code.
